vb_textbox.text: Gnomes are grouped into two sets:red, green, orange and blue purple, pink brown and another colour try to memorise one set of the coloursThe first set take you to a bright forest and the other to a dark forest.The number of mushrooms in each forest goes up and down.If it drops to 4 mushrooms, try the other set of gnomes for at least two goes and see if that forest gives more mushrooms.
